Game Night Buffalo Chicken Pizza
By: Kristi Rimkus
Published: Monday, October 18, 2010 - 6:43am

Ingredients




1 large Culinary Circle Multi-grain Stone Baked Pizza crust
1/2 cup barbecue sauce
1 cup chicken thighs, shredded
1/4 cup red onion, thinly sliced
1 cup spinach, chopped
1/4 cup blue cheese, crumbled
1/4 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
1 dash hot sauce, to taste

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 450. 2 Place pre-cooked pizza dough on a cookie sheet and top with barbecue sauce, chicken, onions, and spinach. Top with hot sauce to taste, then sprinkle one half with blue cheese and the other half with cheddar cheese. 3 Bake for 10 – 12 minutes until cheese melts.

About


This is a quick game night dinner with fantastic buffalo chicken flavors.
